text:
ops-bot: @here Quick availability update — we are opening a limited preview of Dedicated pools for the new NVIDIA Blackwell B500 (b500) in eu-west-mad (Madrid) and ap-northeast-seo (Seoul). Initial inventory: Madrid: 8 GPUs (2 nodes), Seoul: 12 GPUs (3 nodes). Preview is intended for performance validation and early integrations.
eli_pm: Note: this is a preview release only. No SLA, no burst capacity, and not enabled for Dedicated reserved billing yet. If you want early access, please complete the sign-up form (https://redwood.example.com/b500-preview) and include your primary workloads + expected QPS.
sanjay_infra: Pool names are b500-mad-preview and b500-seo-preview. Important operational notes: these nodes do NOT support preemptible mode, HSM-backed KMS is not configured for preview, and we’re enforcing a 6h max session by default. Pricing for the preview is parity priced with current h200-preview tier — we'll finalize retail pricing before GA.
marina_prod: Any guidance on model warmup or quantization for B500? We want to avoid noisy first-token latencies during demos.
sanjay_infra: Good call — recommend pre-warming with 2 short sequences and keep KV cache enabled. We’ve baked a small tuning doc; link in the form above. Example reserve command for test runs:
```
redwood reserve --pool b500-mad-preview --count 1 --duration 4h --team=search --note "b500 smoke test"
```
carlos_sre: Monitoring + alerting: added GPU thermal and ECC metrics to the default SRE dashboard for both pools. Alert thresholds: temp >= 85C, mem errs > 5/min. Alerts will page eng-oncall and infra on-call.
anya_sales: Quick heads-up to GTM teams — this is strictly preview. Please do not promise GA timelines or capacity guarantees to customers yet. If a customer requests early access, route them to the form; we'll handle approvals centrally.
ben_security: Security note — preview nodes are in an isolated VLAN but do NOT have full compliance controls (PCI/ISO) enabled. Do not run regulated datasets on preview pools. We will publish a checklist before GA.
eli_pm: Timeline: preview sign-ups open today; infra will roll nodes to internal testing through the week. If no major blocker, we plan a broader internal power-up next Tuesday and open external early access by the following Monday.
marina_prod: Will we have perf baselines (latency / tokens/sec) to compare against h200 and mi300?
sanjay_infra: Yes — baseline runs are in progress. Preliminary numbers look promising for long-context workloads; we'll post the perf spreadsheet and CI job links in #eng-runtime once finalized.
ops-bot: :tada: Thanks all. If you see any strange behavior, file a bug in the "b500-preview" epic and drop a note in #eng-runtime. We'll triage daily during the preview window.
